blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: We present our solution to the AKBC LM-KBC 2026 Shared Task, where we achieved a score of 0.6836 on the official leaderboard, more than double the baseline of 0.2964. This task requires generating all possible objects for subject-relation pairs using a language model with up to 32 billion parameters, with no retrieval or fine-tuning involved. We show that the prompting methodology is as important as the model architecture: while the instruction-tuned model version achieves 0.5681 with its chat interface, the base model achieves 0.6836 when prompted using text completion. Thus, instruction tuning decreases factual recall; we refer to this effect as the instruction tax, which is caused by the model's weights rather than the prompting method. Our final solution is fairly straightforward: we prompt the base model with some examples from the training data, generate 64--256 outputs, and retain only the repeated ones. Two specialized methods are then applied for each relation: one improves the recall of large answer sets, and the other verifies a person's vitality before predicting their place of death.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了AKBC LM-KBC 2026共享任务解决方案,在正式领导板上取得了0.6836分的成绩,比基线0.2964的两倍多. 这项任务需要使用一个最多有320亿参数的语言模型生成所有可能的对主题关系对象,而不涉及检索或微调. 我们显示,提示方法与模型架构同样重要:虽然指令调制的模型版本用其聊天界面实现了0.5681,但基础模型在使用文本完成的提示时实现了0.6836. 因此,指示调整会减少事实上的召回;我们把这种效果称为指示税,它是由模型的权重而不是催化方法引起的。 我们的最后解决办法相当直截了当:我们通过培训数据中的一些例子,促进基本模式,产生64-256项产出,只保留重复的产出。 然后,对每种关系采用两种专门的方法:一种是改进大答案集的召回,另一种是在预测死亡地点之前验证一个人的活力.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Knowledge graphs (KGs) serve as an essential framework for representing factual information in a structured format, enhancing semantic search and reasoning. Manual curation of such frameworks is expensive, and the resulting graphs always contain substantial information gaps Schneider et al. (2022) ; Hofer et al. (2024) . Although large language models (LLMs) have learned tremendous amounts of factual knowledge implicitly during their pre-training Petroni et al. (2019) , extracting this knowledge is challenging due to prompt sensitivity and hallucinations Jiang et al. (2020) ; Zhang et al. (2025) .
blocks.zh: 知识图(KGs)是用结构化格式表达事实信息,加强语义搜索和推理的基本框架. 这些框架的人工管理费用昂贵,因此所产生的图表中总是包含大量的信息空白Schneider等人(2022年);Hofer等人(2024年)。 虽然大型语言模型在前期培训期间(2019年)隐含地学到了大量的事实知识,但由于迅速的敏感性和幻觉,提取这种知识具有挑战性。 蒋等(2020年); 张等(2025年).

blocks.en: To evaluate progress on these extraction challenges, the AKBC 2026 Shared Task 1 1 1 https://lm-kbc.github.io/challenge2026/ assesses open-weight LLMs with fewer than 32 billion parameters under a strict closed-book setting, where retrieval, external knowledge sources, and fine-tuning are prohibited. The task requires models to predict all valid objects for a given subject–relation pair. For instance, the query (Albert Einstein, city-of-death) should produce the answer Princeton , whereas the query (Barack Obama, city-of-death) should return an empty set because no valid answer exists. This ability to abstain from producing unsupported facts is an essential part of the benchmark, as nearly 20% of the evaluation instances cannot be answered.
blocks.zh: 为了评估这些开采挑战的进展情况,AKBC 2026共同任务1 1 https://lm-kbc.github.io/challenge2026。 在严格封闭的书本设置下,评估不足320亿参数的开放式有限责任公司,禁止检索、外部知识来源和微调。 任务需要模型来预测特定对象–关系对齐的所有有效对象. 例如,查询(Albert Einstein,死亡之城)应该给出普林斯顿的答案,而查询(Barack Obama,死亡之城)应该返回一个空集,因为不存在有效的答案。 这种不产生无根据事实的能力是基准的一个基本部分,因为将近20%的评价事例无法回答。

blocks.en: Our system is inspired by an empirical finding that we name the instruction tax . While instruction-tuned models ( Ouyang et al., 2022 ) are generally favored for question answering tasks, our findings show that instruction-tuned models can sometimes significantly under-perform base models in retrieving facts. For instance, on the area relation, the base model queried by simple text completion outperforms the instruction-tuned model version by 0.29 through its chat interface, and by 0.30 under the same completion prompt. This gap persists despite prompting the instruction-tuned models using completion-style prompts.
blocks.zh: 我们的系统受到一个经验性发现的启发, 我们命名指导税。 虽然指导调制模型(Ouyang等人,2022年)在回答问题的任务上普遍受到青睐,但我们的研究结果表明,指导调制模型有时在获取事实时会明显表现不佳。 例如,关于区域关系,通过简单文本完成而询问的基础模型通过聊天界面以0.29的优于指令调制模型版本,并在相同的完成即时下以0.30的优于该版本。 尽管利用“完成式”提示推动教学调整模式,但这一差距依然存在。

blocks.en: Building on this finding, we developed a system based on five methodological principles: (1) choosing the base model through a fast probing process that takes about one GPU-hour; (2) prompting the base model using few-shot continuations rather than asking questions explicitly; (3) sampling 64–256 times for each row, and keeping only what recurs and returning empty if there is no recurrence; (4) adding a verification step for low-frequency examples in relations with hundreds of possible answers; and (5) breaking down more complicated tasks, such as checking whether the person is dead before predicting the city-of-death . Code, prompts, fitted thresholds, and the commands that reproduce each table are available at https://github.com/aiamourad/lm-kbc-2026/ .
blocks.zh: 基于这一结论,我们发展了一个基于五个方法原则的系统:(1) 通过一个大约一个GPU小时的快速探测过程选择基准模型;(2) 利用几发续弹而不是明确提问来推动基准模型;(3) 每行取样64-256次,如果不再发生,只保留发生和返回的空弹;(4) 在与数百个可能答案的关系中,增加一个低频实例的核查步骤;(5) 破解更复杂的任务,如在预测死亡城市之前,先检查此人是否死亡。 代码、提示、加装阈值以及复制每个表格的命令见https://github.com/aiamourad/lm-kbc-2026/ 。 。 。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Language models have been tested for factual recall in multiple studies. The LAMA benchmark was introduced by Petroni et al. (2019) and consists of factual questions answered using the fill-in-the-blank format. Roberts et al. (2020) showed that a fine-tuned model can answer factual questions from its parameters alone, and Brown et al. (2020) showed the same without weight updates, using
a few in-context examples as prompts. Still, factual recall is notably less effective for long-tail entities ( Sun et al., 2024 ) , making long-tail entities the hard case for our task. The LM-KBC benchmark ( Singhania et al., 2022 ) adds an evaluation setting for factual recall that requires predicting the entire set of answers and compares the predictions against accepted aliases.
blocks.zh:
语言模型在多项研究中被测试为事实召回. LAMA基准由Petroni等人(2019年)提出,由使用填充格式回答的事实问题组成。 Roberts等人(2020年)表明,微调模型可以单从其参数中解答事实问题,而Brown等人(2020年)则在不更新重量的情况下显示出同样的问题。
作为提示的几个文本中的例子。 然而,事实上的召回对于长尾实体(Sun等人,2024年)来说,效果明显较低,使长尾实体成为我们任务的硬道理。 LM-KBC基准(Singhania等人,2022年)增加了事实召回的评价设置,要求预测整套答案,并将预测与接受的别名进行比较.

blocks.en: Instruction tuning enhances the ability to follow instructions but can impair other abilities ( Ouyang et al., 2022 ) , with Zhou et al. (2023) arguing that it alters behavior more than knowledge. This paper quantifies these impacts in terms of factual recall. In addition, our method employs repeated sampling, akin to the self-consistency approach ( Wang et al., 2023 ; Manakul et al., 2023 ) , and examines the trade-off between efficiency and recall in mixture-of-experts models ( Fedus et al., 2022 ) .
blocks.zh: 指令调制提高了遵循指令的能力,但可能损害其他能力(欧阳等人,2022年),而周等人(2023年)则认为其改变行为比改变知识要多. 本文从实际召回的角度量化了这些影响。 此外,我们的方法采用重复取样,类似于自我一致性方法(Wang等人,2023年;Manakul等人,2023年),并审查专家混合模型中效率和召回之间的权衡(Fedus等人,2022年)。

blocks.zh: 3 AKBC 共享任务和计量

blocks.en: 3.1 Dataset
blocks.zh: 3.1 数据集

blocks.en: This task contains six relationships and has 477, 475, and 475 examples in the train/val/test splits, respectively. There are two numerical relationships ( hasArea , hasCapacity ) for which the answer is a single number, and it is correct if it differs from the ground-truth answer by no more than ±5%. zz awardWonBy may have up to several hundred objects that the model must list to be considered correct. The remaining three relationships (countries (or comparable territories) that share a land border with the subject ( countryLandBordersCountry ), the stock exchange(s) on which the company’s shares are publicly traded ( companyTradesAtStockExchange ), the city where the person died ( personHasCityOfDeath )) have small answer sets that are empty for 18–42% of training rows.

blocks.en: 4 Model Selection
blocks.zh: 4 模式选择

blocks.en: Which model should we select, and how should we interact with it? To this end, we provide the answers by means of an easy and cheap procedure called the knowledge probe . It consists of about 100 examples with known answers. For each of them, we query each of the models under consideration using several phrasings to ask for the corresponding fact and sample their answers 8–12 times. Next, we compute how often each particular answer was generated.
blocks.zh: 我们应该选择哪种模式,我们应如何与它互动? 为此,我们通过一种简便而廉价的程序提供答案,称为知识探测器。 它包括大约100个有已知答案的例子。 对于每个模型,我们用几种措辞查询每个模型,以询问相应的事实,并抽查它们的答案8至12次。 接下来,我们计算每个特定答案的生成频率。

blocks.en: This results in two scores for each candidate model. The first one is called voted and stands for the proportion of examples whose most frequently returned answer is the correct one. The second one is the ceiling , i.e., the proportion of examples for which the correct answer appears at least once in the generated responses. This score reflects the upper limit of performance under such a probing procedure, since no selection strategy can return an answer that does not occur in the samples.
blocks.zh: 这导致每个候选人模式都有2个分数。 第一个被称作表决,代表最经常得到正确答案的例子比例。 第二个是上限,即正确答案至少出现在生成的答复中一次的例子比例。 这一分数反映了在这种测试程序下业绩的上限,因为任何选择策略都无法返回样本中没有的答案.

blocks.en: We probe the two numeric relations, as each sample yields a single number that can be parsed and checked automatically against the 5% tolerance threshold.
blocks.zh: 我们探索两种数字关系,因为每个样本产生一个单一的数字,可以解析并自动对照5%的耐受阈值检查.

blocks.en: Table 1 highlights the results that were derived from around one GPU-hour of computing effort per model version, and this guided the selection of the model. In the probe we ask for the same fact in several different wordings, such as "The area of X X is" or " X X covers an area of". For each model version, we then report only the score of its best wording. We pick that wording using the same 100 rows we score on, so these numbers are a little too high. We treat every model version in the same way, but this helps a model more when its wordings give very different results. The table is therefore best used to rank the model versions, not to predict what one fixed prompt would score. Dense models outperformed the mixture-of-experts (MoE) model across all the experiments. While the evaluation counts an MoE model by its total number of parameters, not all of these parameters get activated per token, and the performance appears to depend on the amount of such computation. The reasoning-tuned model does not provide any noticeable improvement.
blocks.zh: 表1突出了每个模型版本大约一个GPU小时的计算工作所产生的结果,这为模型的选择提供了指导。 在探测器中,我们在几个不同的措辞中要求同样的事实,如"X X的面积是"或"X X覆盖一个区域". 对于每个模式版本,我们只报告其最佳措辞的得分。 我们用我们得分相同的100行来选择这个措辞,所以这些数字有点过高. 我们以同样的方式对待每个模型版本,但当一个模型的措辞产生非常不同的结果时,这更有助于它. 因此,该表最好用来对模型版本进行排序,而不是用来预测一个固定的提示的得分. 在所有实验中,Dense模型的性能超过了混合专家模型。 虽然评价按总参数数计算出一个MOE模型,但并非所有这些参数都能被激活,而且性能似乎取决于这种计算的数量。 推理调整模式没有带来任何明显的改进。

blocks.en: We observe a discrepancy between the scores of the base 0.880 and instruction-tuned 0.59 version of the gemma-3-27b model. To analyze whether the following is resulting from the nature of the prompt, we prompt the instruction-tuned model using the same completion prompt (compl. under it-tuned in Table 1 ) used for the base model version. Even with an identical query, it fell short at 0.580, and the sample ceiling falls from 0.950 to 0.690. This gives us a clearer image that the tuned model forgot facts it learned.
blocks.zh: 我们观察到基数0.880的分数与Gemma-3-27b模型的指令调值0.59的分数之间有差异. 为了分析以下是否由速率的性质产生,我们用同样完成速率(在表1下将其调制)来启动用于基准模型版本的指令调制模型. 即便有相同的查询,它仍以0.580的不足,抽样上限也从0.950降至0.690. 这给了我们一个更清晰的形象, 调制模型忘记了它学到的事实。

blocks.en: To check how consistent this pattern is, we test three additional pairs (gemma-3-12b, gemma-2-27b, and Mistral-Nemo-2407). In all eight tests, the base model version is at least as good as the instruction-tuned model version on both numerical relations. This appears to be a feature not inherent to instruction tuning per se, but dependent on the particular tuning run. Inside the Gemma family, the difference is 0.290 for gemma-3-27b and 0.350 for gemma-3-12b, but only 0.080 for gemma-2-27b, even though it is the same size as gemma-3-27b. In other words, with one generation less, the same tuning carries only a quarter of the cost. Mistral-Nemo-2407 also shows this small difference of 0.080.
blocks.zh: 为了检查这个模式是否一致,我们测试了另外三对(gemma-3-12b,gemma-227b,和Mistral-Nemo-2407). 在所有的8个测试中,基础模型版本至少与两个数字关系上的指令调制模型版本一样好. 这似乎不是一个指令调谐本身所固有的特征,而是取决于特定的调谐运行. 在Gemma家族内部,其差异为:Gemma-3-27b0.290,Gemma-3-12b0.350,但Gemma-227b只有0.080,尽管其大小与Gemma-3-27b相同. 换句话说,只要少一代人,同样的调音只承担四分之一的费用。 Mistral-Nemo-2407也显示了这个0.080的小差.

blocks.en: The key difference between the two cases lies in the ceiling. With a high tax, performance on the matched completion prompt becomes very poor: dropping from 0.950 to 0.690 in gemma-3-27b, and from 0.840 to 0.470 in gemma-3-12b. With a low tax, the ceiling remains almost intact, dropping merely from 0.820 to 0.770 in gemma-2-27b, and from 0.900 to 0.870 in Mistral-Nemo-2407. It seems, therefore, that a high tax results in the loss of some answers from the sampling distribution, whereas a low tax results in poor answer selection from the remaining sample. Since both can be quantified using the same one-hour probe, the distinction can be made prior to committing to a model version.
blocks.zh: 这两种情况的主要区别在于上限。 由于税额很高,在相应的完成速率上的表现变得非常差:gemma-3-27b的成绩从0.950降至0.690,gemma-3-12b的成绩从0.840降至0.470。 由于税率低,上限几乎保持不变,仅从gemma-227b的0.820降至0.770,而米斯特拉尔-内莫-2407的上限则从0.900降至0.870. 因此,高税率似乎导致抽样分配中的一些答案丢失,而低税率则导致从其余抽样中选择的答案差。 由于两者都可以使用同一个一小时的探测器进行量化,在承诺使用模型版本之前可以进行区分.

blocks.en: As shown in Section 6 , the probe order matches the order of the official submission runs, suggesting that the probing evaluation serves as an effective proxy for full submissions. The final system employs the base model version, gemma-3-27b-pt ( Gemma Team, 2025 ) , for all six relations.
blocks.zh: 如第6节所示,探测令与正式提交请求的顺序相符,这表明探测评估是提交全部请求的有效代用。 最终系统使用基模版本gemma-3-27b-pt(Gemma Team,2025年),用于所有六种关系.

blocks.en: 5 Methodology
blocks.zh: 5. 方法

blocks.en: For inference, we deploy only one model ( gemma-3-27b-pt ) for the whole set of tasks. This model has 27.43 billion parameters, obtained precisely by counting the released weights rather than relying on the model’s name, which may be incorrect. Within the task’s 32-billion-parameter budget, it is impossible to deploy any other useful model in parallel with it. Inference is provided with the help of vLLM ( Kwon et al., 2023 ) using two H100 GPUs and thus is performed for the whole test split in just a few minutes.
blocks.zh: 推论,我们只为整组任务部署一个模型(gemma-3-27b-pt). 这个模型有274.3亿个参数,精确地通过计算释放的重量来获得,而不是依靠模型的名字,这可能不正确. 在任务320亿参数的预算中,不可能同时部署任何其他有用的模式。 推论是在vLLM(Kwon等人,2023年)的帮助下,使用两个H100GPU提供的,因此在几分钟内进行整个测试分裂.

blocks.en: For each relation, there is one completion template (see Table 2 ). A prompt is composed of a few examples selected from the training dataset and ends with an unfinished example that corresponds to the subject of the query:
blocks.zh: 每个关系都有一个完成模板(见表2)。 提示由从培训数据集中选择的几个例子组成,结尾是一个未完成的例子,与查询的主题相对应:

blocks.en: The total area of Lake Victoria is 68800 square kilometres. The total area of Bodensee is 536 square kilometres. The total area of Vygozero is
blocks.zh: 维多利亚湖的总面积为68800平方公里. 博登西的总面积为536平方公里. 维戈泽罗的总面积是

blocks.en: Such a formulation will naturally encourage the continuation of the observed pattern rather than an interpretation of the input as an instruction. There is no chat template and no task-specific instruction, and the model receives only the text in the exact form it should produce.
blocks.zh: 这种提法自然会鼓励继续采用所观察到的模式,而不是将投入解释为一种指示。 没有聊天模板,也没有针对特定任务的指令,模型只能以它应该产生的确切形式接收文本.

blocks.en: There are two crucial design decisions here. First of all, the numerical examples are chosen in such a way that they cover the whole distribution of numbers in the training dataset, including one sample from each quintile. This will prevent a bias towards a certain numerical range in the prompt. Second, examples with an empty response in the case of set-valued relations make up about one third of the exemplars and are marked as "none".
blocks.zh: 这里有两个关键的设计决定。 首先,选择数字实例的方式是,它们涵盖培训数据集中数字的整个分布,包括从每五分之一中抽取一个样本。 这将防止在提示中偏向某个数字范围。 其二,设定值关系中出现空响应的例子约占实例的三分之一,并标注为"无".

blocks.en: Each row is sampled n n times with different random seeds, and every output is truncated at the first line break. The temperature is 0.7 throughout. The exact value matters little: between 0.3 and 1.3 the differences stay within noise once the decision thresholds are refitted. Only very low temperatures do real damage, making the 64 samples nearly identical, collapsing the process to a single completion and removing the small benefit of aggregation.
blocks.zh: 每行以不同的随机种子采样nn次,每行输出在第一行间断时均截断. 整个温度是0.7 准确值无关紧要:一旦决定阈值被重新确定,0.3至1.3之间的差异就停留在噪音之内。 只有非常低的温度才造成实际破坏,使64个样本几乎完全相同,使过程完全崩溃,并消除了聚合带来的小好处。

blocks.en: We then parse the outputs into the required format for each relation type: a single numeric answer for numeric relations, and a comma-separated list for set-valued relations, where the output "none" denotes the empty set. Prior to aggregation, the responses are normalized in the same way as in the evaluation script: string-valued answers are merged according to the scorer’s normalization rules, and numeric answers are grouped using the scorer’s 5% tolerance.
blocks.zh: 然后,我们将输出解析为每个关系类型所需的格式:一个数字关系的单一数字答案,以及一个设置值关系以逗号分隔的列表,其中输出"无"表示空集. 在汇总之前,反应的正常化方式与评价脚本相同:字符串值的答案按照计分者的常态规则进行合并,数字解答则使用计分者的5%容忍度进行分组.

blocks.en: For numerical relations, denote the parsed samples as v 1 , … , v m v_{1},\dots,v_{m} , where m ≤ n m\leq n because not every output parses into a number. For each candidate c c , the cluster C ⁡ ( c ) C(c) is formed by all those samples lying within 5% of c c , and the prediction is the median of the biggest cluster: v ^ = median ⁡ C ⁡ ( c ∗ ) , c ∗ = arg ​ max c ⁡ | C ⁡ ( c ) | , \hat{v}=\operatorname{median}C(c^{\ast}),\quad c^{\ast}=\operatorname*{arg\,max}_{c}|C(c)|, (2) where C ⁡ ( c ) = { v i : | v i − c | ≤ 0.05 ​ c } C(c)=\{\,v_{i}:|v_{i}-c|\leq 0.05\,c\,\} . This can be considered as majority voting modified to match the evaluation function: since the scorer allows any prediction that is within 5 percent of the reference value, votes are counted on tolerance clusters and not on numeric equality.

blocks.en: The threshold τ r \tau_{r} is the sole parameter fitted for each relation independently. Instead of picking it manually, we pick the one that achieves the best official score on the training examples, and re-fit it each time either the number of samples n n or the number of exemplars k k is modified. These thresholds are more conservative for those relations where misprediction carries a high cost. In particular, for personHasCityOfDeath , the system will predict the city only if at least 40% of the 128 samples vote for it. For those relations having a bigger reference set, the fitted threshold is typically smaller. Abstention is a natural consequence of the same approach, since if none of the candidates achieves the needed recurrence rate, the predicted set is empty.
blocks.zh: 阈值\ r\ tau_{r} 是每个关系独立安装的唯一参数 。 与其手工选取,不如选取在训练实例上取得最佳官方分数的选手,每次修改样本n n 或例数 k k 时都要重新配对. 这些门槛对于错误预测费用高昂的关系更为保守。 特别是对于HasCityOf Death的人来说,只有128个样本中至少有40%的人投了票,系统才会预测城市。 对于参考范围较大的关系,适用的门槛通常较小。 放弃是同一办法的自然结果,因为如果没有一个候选人达到所需的复发率,那么预测的一套是空的。

blocks.en:
The relation awardWonBy is especially challenging because its answer set can have hundreds of names. In such a situation, it is difficult to differentiate the genuine candidate, which only occurs three times among 64 samples, from the hallucinated candidate by recurrence alone. For this reason, we employ the model as a second-stage verifier using completion. We first present the model with ten verification examples from the training set that are evenly divided into positive and negative examples (e.g., Did Barack Obama get the Nobel Peace Prize? yes and Did Marie Curie get the Turing Award? no ), and then pose the same question to the model regarding the candidate. We sample the verification question eight times, and let q ⁡ ( a ) q(a) be the ratio of samples answered with yes. We then add back the candidates whose support is at least 2 / 64 2/64 and whose q ⁡ ( a ) ≥ 0.75 q(a)\geq 0.75 .
The two threshold values are chosen based on training examples. In the verification process, true positives are separated from false positives by means of the Area Under the Curve (AUC), which has a value of 0.86 on training candidates (0.75 on validation candidates). Lastly, we perform a non-neural clean-up procedure to combine duplicate names such as "Robert Caro" and "Robert A. Caro". Without performing this step, the scorer would consider both entries to be different predictions.
blocks.zh:
关系裁决 WonBy尤其具有挑战性,因为它的答案集可以有数百个名字. 在这种情况下,很难将真正候选人与幻觉候选人区分开来,而真正的候选人在64个样本中只出现3次,仅通过重复出现。 为此,我们利用该模型作为使用完成的第二阶段核查员。 我们首先从培训中提出10个核查实例,这些实例均分为正面和负面实例(例如,巴拉克·奥巴马获得诺贝尔和平奖了吗? 是的,玛丽・居里得到图灵奖了吗? 我们抽样核查问题8次,让q q(a) q(a)作为回答为 " 是 " 的样本比例。 然后,我们再补充以下候选人:其支持至少为2/64 2/64,其q = 0.75 q(a)\ geq 0.75。
这两个阈值是根据培训实例选定的。 在核查过程中,真阳性与假阳性通过曲线下的区域(AUC)进行分离,该区域对培训候选人(关于验证候选人的0.75)的价值为0.86. 最后,我们进行非神经性清理程序,将"罗伯特·卡罗"和"罗伯特·A·卡罗"等重复名称结合起来. 不执行这一步骤,计分员会认为这两个条目都是不同的预测.

blocks.en: Approximately 40% of the death-relation rows refer to people who are still alive, and the correct answer in such cases is the empty set. We took a two-step approach in which we identify whether a given subject is dead or alive. If the person is alive, we ask the model to assign the empty set. On the other hand, if the model is confident that the person is indeed dead, we ask it to recall the location of their death.
blocks.zh: 大约40%的死因关系排指仍然活着的人,在这种情况下正确的答案是空格. 我们采取了分两步走的办法,即确定一个特定主体是死是活。 如果这个人还活着,我们请模型指定空集. 另一方面,如果模型相信此人确实已经死亡,我们请它回顾他们的死亡地点.

blocks.en: Information about whether the person is alive or dead is far more prevalent than information about where they died. The location of the death is tail knowledge, while the person’s living status is more widespread. We exploit this difference as an initial filter, which we call the existence check : it predicts whether an object exists for the row at all, rather than which object it is. For every query, we take 16 samples of a separate completion, built from ten exemplars evenly split between living and dead subjects of the training split, of the form As of 1 July 2026, {s} is alive/dead , followed by the query subject. If all 16 samples predict that the person is alive, then the answer must be the empty set.
blocks.zh: 有关该人生死的信息远比关于他们死在哪里的信息更为普遍。 死亡地点为尾部知识,而该人的居住状况则更为普遍. 我们利用这种区别作为初始过滤器,我们称之为存在检查 : 它预测一个对象是否完全存在于行中,而不是它是什么对象。 每一次查询,我们都会抽取16个单独完成的样本,由10个实例组成,在训练分开的活生生的科目和死生科目之间平分,表格从2026年7月1日起,{s}是活/死的,然后是查询科目. 如果所有16个样本都预言那个人还活着,那么答案必须是空集.

blocks.en: Firstly, there is an instruction tax , which is significant, especially when it comes to relations that rely heavily on exact recall (Table 4 ). Within one weights family, using the base model for completion instead of the instruction-tuned model via the chat interface increases the score by + 0.116 +0.116 . The greatest improvement can be seen in the numeric relations, namely area ( + 0.203 +0.203 ) and capacity ( + 0.156 +0.156 ). In fact, the base model outperforms the instruction-tuned model on every single relation.

blocks.en: The comparison only makes sense if the instruction-based model is a strong one. To ensure this, we created a detailed prompt with a few-shot examples and challenged the model with yes-or-no questions for each query. More details are provided in Appendix B . Even after giving the instruction-tuned system all these additional advantages, the simpler completion-based system still performed better on every relation. Our findings imply a strong difference between the base and instruction-tuned models when it comes to factual knowledge recall: the facts recoverable by the base model become extremely rare in the output of the instruction-tuned model.
blocks.zh: 如果基于教学的模型是强的,这种比较才有意义。 为了保证这一点,我们创建了带有几个镜头例子的详细提示,并以每个查询的"是"或"否"的问题挑战模型. 详见附录B。 即使赋予了指导调整系统所有这些额外优势,基于完成的较简单的系统在每种关系上都表现较好。 我们的调查结果意味着,在事实知识回顾方面,基准模型和经指导调整的模型之间有很大的区别:在经指导调整的模型的输出中,通过基准模型可收回的事实变得极为罕见。

blocks.en:
Secondly, the ranking method of Table 1 has predicted each ordering in the official submission runs accurately, as the lower block of Table 4 shows. The dense models were ranked ahead of the MoE model (0.568 and 0.613 against 0.534) under the same instruction-tuned system, and the base checkpoint was ranked ahead of all of them at 0.681. The point is that the decisions which are key to achieving the highest score, model and interface, can be determined using only one GPU hour of computing time.
Thirdly, sampling should be increased until little or nothing is gained, and this appears to be contingent on the relation. The official score increased from 0.6218 with n = 8 n{=}8 samples to 0.6292 with n = 24 n{=}24 samples, and again to 0.6604 with n = 64 n{=}64 samples, the latter one being computed using the company format in Table 2 . More samples were useful for some relations; for set relations, the gains continued until n = 128 n{=}128 , while for the company relation, the optimal number was found to be n = 256 n{=}256 . The verification rescue contributed an additional + 0.027 +0.027 on its relation, and the existence check contributed + 0.030 +0.030 on the death relation, which gave 0.6809. Doubling the samples for the numeric relations ( n = 128 n{=}128 ) did not help, so n = 64 n{=}64 already saturates them.
blocks.zh:
第二,表1的排名方法预测了正式提交的每个顺序,如表4的下一组所示。 密集型号在同一个指令调制系统下排名领先于MOE型号(0.568和0.613对0.534),基地检查站以0.681的成绩排在全部车次前. 关键在于对于实现最高分数,模型和接口至关重要的决定,只能使用一个GPU小时的计算时间来确定.
第三,应该增加抽样,直到得到的很少或一无所获,这似乎取决于有关关系。 官方得分从0.6218分,n=8n{=}8个样本增加到0.6292分,n=24n{=}24个样本,再次增加到0.6604分,n=64n{=}64个样本,后一种样本采用表2中的公司格式计算. 更多的样本对一些关系有用;对于定型关系,收益一直持续到n=128n{=}128,而对于公司关系,发现最佳数字为n=256n{=}256. 核查营救在关系上额外贡献了+0.027+0.027,存在检查在死亡关系上贡献了+0.030+0.030,给出了0.6809. 将样本复制成数值关系(n = 128 n{=}128)没有帮助,因此n = 64 n{=}64已经饱和.

blocks.en: Last, much of the gain comes from knowing when to say nothing (last two rows of Table 3 ). Empty exemplar lines plus the training-fitted threshold give an abstention F1 of 0.773; the existence check raises it to 0.798 and death precision to 0.900. The check catches an error recurrence cannot: the model naming a city, consistently, for someone still alive.
blocks.zh: 最后,大部分收益来自知道何时什么也别说(表3最后两行)。 空的示例线加上训练适应阈值给出了0.773的弃权F1;存在检查将其提高到0.798,死亡精度提高到0.900. 检查会发现一个错误的重现不能:模型将一个城市命名为一个始终如一的,为某个还活着的人命名.

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: The design of our system rests on one insight: when it comes to factual recall, instruction tuning is not worth the expense. On the same parameters, gemma-3-27b-it scores 0.568 through its chat interface, while gemma-3-27b-pt scores 0.684 by completion. The rest follows: a one-GPU-hour probe selects the model version and the interface, each row is sampled between 64 and 256 times from the completion prompt, and only those responses above a fitted threshold are retained, making abstention the norm rather than the exception. The final score is 0.6836, against 0.2964 for the task’s baseline. Two takeaways should apply elsewhere: the model version and the interface need to be tested, and where the best answer is often empty, knowing when not to answer helps almost as much as knowing more.
blocks.zh: 我们系统的设计基于一种见解:关于事实记忆,指示调整并不值得花费。 在同一参数上,gemma-3-27b-it通过它的聊天界面得分0.568,而gemma-3-27b-pt则通过完成得分0.684. 其余部分如下: 一个1GPU小时的探测器选择模型版本和接口,每行从完成即刻开始采样在64到256次之间,只保留那些超过一个安装阈值的响应,使规范成为弃权而非例外. 最后得分为0.6836分,而任务基线为0.2964分. 两件外卖应在别处适用:模型版本和界面需要测试,在哪些地方,最好的答案往往是空的,知道何时不回答几乎等于知道更多。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: The instruction tax is calculated on four (base, instruct) pairs. Officially, changing the weights alone costs 0.085 for gemma-3-27b and gemma-3-12b, whose sampling ceiling collapses, but 0.016 for Mistral-Nemo-2407 and 0.000 for gemma-2-27b, whose ceiling holds: the size of the tax depends on the tuning process, and four families are not enough to determine its applicability. The system is also quite costly, taking 64–256 generations to process each row, while the instruction-tuned baseline uses only one, and it is not zero-shot: the prompts are constructed from the training rows with labels, and the thresholds have to be recalibrated every time either n n or k k changes. The verification rescue and the existence check were each crafted by hand for a single relation.
blocks.zh: 指导税按四对(基准,指示)计算. 官方规定,光是改变重量就花费了0.085美元,Gemma-3-27b和Gemma-3-12b的采样天花板崩溃,但Mistral-Nemo-2407的0.016和Gemma-227b的0.000,其上限维持:税额大小取决于调制过程,四个家庭不足以决定其适用性. 系统成本也相当高,每行处理需要64–256代人,而指令调试基线只使用一个,而不是零镜头:提示从训练行中构建,标签,每次n n 或 k k 变化时,阈值都必须重新校正. 核查救援和存在检查都是用手为单一关系设计的。

blocks.en: Appendix B The Instruction-tuned Comparator in Full
blocks.zh: 附录B 指导调整的完全比较

blocks.en: This appendix outlines the instruction-tuned system deployed for the "it, chat" row in Table 4 . Of all the instruction-tuned models we experimented with, this is our best system, which scored 0.5681 with gemma-3-27b-it and 0.6127 with Mistral-Small-3.2-24B. The second model achieved 0.6161 when the border rules discussed in Appendix B were applied. This system utilizes a very simple process that entails generating the potential answers, evaluating them separately, calibrating the scores, and choosing the highest-scoring combination.
blocks.zh: 本附录概述了为表4中的"it, chalk"行而部署的指令调试系统. 在我们试验过的所有指令调制模型中,这是我们最好的系统,它与gemma-3-27b-it的分数为0.5681,与Mistral-Small-3.2-24B的分数为0.6127. 第二种模式在适用附录B所讨论的边界规则时达到了0.6161。 这个系统使用一个非常简单的过程,它涉及生成潜在的答案,分别评价它们,校准分数,选择得分最高的组合.

blocks.en: The relation question is asked of the model for each row n n times. Instead of using temperature to generate different outputs, we provide each sample with a new approach instruction , which is a one-sentence hint on how to solve the problem, e.g., "Walk around the country’s borders clockwise and name its neighbours" or "First figure out whether the person was alive in 2026." In practice, it results in more productive disagreements among the samples compared to changing the temperature. Constrained decoding is used to make sure that the outputs remain in the same JSON format. Each of the prompts contains the definition of the relation given in the task and six example rows from the training set.
blocks.zh: 每行nn次都会对模型提出关系问题. 而不是用温度来产生不同的产出, 我们向每个样本提供一个新的方法指示, 即一意孤行的提示, 如何解决问题, 在实践中,与温度变化相比,它导致样品之间产生更多的分歧。 节制解码用于确保输出保持相同的JSON格式. 每个提示都包含任务中给出的关系定义,以及训练集的6个例行.

blocks.en: Each candidate solution is then verified individually. The model receives a statement of the form "X is one of the correct answers to …", and replies with either "Yes" or "No". Rather than sampling this reply, we take the log-probabilities of the first token: the score q q is the probability mass on the tokens spelling "Yes", divided by the mass on "Yes" plus "No". The value of q q obtained in this way is not always equally robust for different relations. For instance, it achieves an AUC of 0.931 for awardWonBy while reaching 0.450 for the border relation, a result inferior even to the random chance baseline. Owing to such variations, we do not fix any threshold for q q ; rather, we consider it to be one signal among others forwarded to the next step.
blocks.zh: 然后逐个核查每个候选解决方案。 模型收到表单的语句"X是对...的正确答案之一",并以"是"或"否"来回答. 我们不采样这个答复,而是取第一个符号的对数概率:分数 q q是拼写"是"的符号上的概率质量,除以"是"和"否"上的质量. 通过这种方式获得的q q的价值对于不同的关系并不总是同样坚固. 例如,它获得的AUC为0.931 WonBy在边境关系达到0.450的同时,结果甚至低于随机机会基线. 由于这种变化,我们没有为qq确定任何阈值;相反,我们认为,这是向下一步传递的信号之一。

blocks.en: Both of them use reference data only, and predictions by the system itself are not considered evidence at all. In the case of the Mistral-Small-3.2-24B instruction-tuned system, the rules increased borders from 0.9487 to 0.9729 official and from 0.6127 to 0.6161 total. In the completion system, in which borders achieve 0.989 on validation with recall 1.000, the rules failed to pass the validation gate and were not used (Section 6 ).
blocks.zh: 两人只使用参考数据,系统本身的预测完全不被视为证据. 在Mistral-Small-3.2-24B指令调制系统中,规则将边界从0.9487增加到0.9729正式边界,从0.6127增加到0.6161。 在竣工系统中,边界在1.000次召回的验证上达到0.989,规则未能通过验证门,没有使用(第6节)。
